question: Where do macro capability/audit inventories, feature completeness/coverage gates, harness/task/review control-plane evidence, canonical tool/agent registries and documentation/plan fidelity work?

selectedFiles.reason: Complete native inventory, snapshot/ignore rules, feature candidate discovery, maturity classification, evidence promotion and structural/feature coverage evaluator. Reuse the parent's saved completeness and snapshot probes; assess what the gate actually proves and how its categories support capability truth.

Real SDK entrypoints and snapshot cache/root binding; producer of heuristic feature coverage receipts and consumer of caller-supplied structural/feature evidence. Trace stale snapshots, scoped inventories, explicit verification and error shapes through the current tool contract.

Runtime-derived report path, Markdown rendering, compact structural receipt, exact-byte idempotent collision handling and exclusive mutation-backed persistence. Trace whether report acceptance binds the actual durable bytes, snapshot and payload rather than only the caller's declarations.

Canonical structured finding and audit coverage input schemas: severity/domain normalization, identifiers, uniqueness/hygiene, noIssuesFound consistency, snapshot-bound completeness and normalized legacy input. Output receipt schemas are a bounded secondary reference.

Existing inventory/completeness tests and schema/SDK coverage-gate tests, including nested receipt identity and verified evidence. Distinguish tested category membership/attestation from executable producer-to-consumer behavior; later snapshot/promotion tests and the parent's existing counterexamples are references.

Minimum complete shard-pair gate, structural coverage matrix, planner output coverage, every-subsystem enumeration and integrated sharding verdict. Inspect what is machine-checked from traces/output and what remains merely self-reported; breadth classifier and regression cases are secondary.

Canonical native tool descriptor registry and alias projection: visible capability names and audit/harness/review/task definitions. Follow constants, provider schemas, runtime handler and SDK dispatch references to separate published membership from usable production wiring.

Complete reviewer definition: grants, read-only evidence gathering, structured attested output, dimensions, requirement coverage, test-quality/compatibility/security rules and native set_output contract. Compare this declared review assurance with the actual gate parser, credit rules and public docs.

Dependency-safe canonical quality/security/decision/specialist and broad-audit instructions consumed by bundled agents/runtime. Trace native snapshot/feature/coverage requirements and canonical documentation references through re-exports and real orchestrator consumers.

Worktree identity builder and real review-bundle entrypoint: full versus capped Git evidence, committed delivery handling, snapshot identity, task/workspace state, ownership/validation/open-finding filtering and security scan packet. Earlier byte hashing/baseline helpers and targeted validation are references.

Test-impact and build-target production assembly: convention/graph/build-tool tiers, confidence/confirmation, owning workspace, discovered manifest scripts and async consumers. Examine whether capability/readiness/test targeting claims accurately represent the evidence and actual target-project language/toolchain support.

Complete typed local control-plane record store: repository/workspace/run/snapshot/revision identities, per-kind records, filesystem locks, atomic write/CAS behavior, reads, corruption quarantine and diagnostic retention. Pair05 owns its already-probed lease/snapshot continuation issues; focus how evidence producers and review consumers compose.

Root public product and SDK contract: local/BYOK operation, coordinated agents, natural-language coding, installation/setup, custom generators, SDK examples and model/provider configuration. Compare advertised entrypoints/behaviors with audited production consumers and separate measured assurance from claims.

Current whole-product design source of truth, implementation/acceptance status, coverage versus live evidence limits, information/evidence hierarchy, recovery/approval/session states and product flow contract. Treat documented open acceptance as open; compare current claims with actual supported body abilities.

Public harness-control-plane and specialist-intelligence capability contract: task/review evidence, environment/workspace/test/build/context/ownership/readiness roles. Check default/optional/unwired distinctions through selected SDK implementations and bounded consumers.

Public reviewer verdict/coverage/requirement/failure contract, parent-owned process scope and structured/text fallback claims. Compare the current code-reviewer schema and gate helpers rather than treating documentation or a model verdict as independent implementation assurance.

Current switch/default/optional/deprecated/availability inventory and explicit inference limits. Use as a discovery/contract map for macro capabilities; do not infer that every option is a disabled feature or that an inventory entry proves user reachability.

Root public workspaces, runtime/tooling versions, package manager and documented development/validation/generation entrypoints. Assess architecture and doc fidelity; pair11 owns CI, benchmark execution and release/packaging correctness.

Only the assigned picker JSON is written; no findings, source fixes, tests/probes, model/API calls, private configs, credentials, or previous private logs.
